description: Read the error code off the single ERROR line of a day at a distillery's still house, whose WARN lines also watch the same cooling water. DISTILL-CANARY-b04ad460

files.README.md:
# Lochnagar Distillery - still house journal

One line per charge, cut or alarm. ERROR lines carry the fault code; the
watcher's WARN and INFO lines carry no codes.
